label: HABIT 1
head: Get off the floor with no hands
sub: Sit on the floor while you watch TV. Stand up without using your hands.

label: HABIT 2
head: Dead hang for 30 seconds
sub: Opens tight shoulders and takes load off your spine. Feet on the floor at first is fine.

label: HABIT 3
head: Hold a deep squat
sub: Hold a doorframe and sit low for a minute. Add slow ankle circles.

label: HABIT 4
head: Balance on one foot
sub: 30 seconds per leg, every time you brush.

head: Use it or lose it
l: Stiff hips and a sore back at 35

text: Your body closes off any range you *stop using.*
